title: Build IT practice labs and log them to a portfolio
summary: An IT learner sends one voice note and their AI agent builds the day's lab, documents it, takes screenshots and updates their GitHub portfolio, they say in minutes.
agent_role: The agent builds the lab, writes up what was built and why, gives steps to repeat it, makes screenshots and publishes to GitHub. The human sends a single voice note and refines the process.
outcome: Author reports the day's single sign-on lab took 2 minutes to build and the portfolio updated automatically.
what_they_did: The poster is doing a 30-day challenge of building IT practice labs. On day 3 they set up single sign-on for Jenkins using Microsoft Entra ID. They now send one voice note, and their agent builds the lab, documents it with replication steps, generates screenshots and updates their GitHub portfolio.
how_it_went: They say the lab took 2 minutes. The day 1 to 3 portfolio cards were generated by the agent straight from their lab environment.
worth_knowing: The poster says most of their time went into refining the documenting and publishing process, not building the labs themselves.
prompt: I'm building IT practice labs to grow my portfolio. Today's lab: [lab topic, e.g. single sign-on for an app]. Build it in [my lab environment]. Then write a short write-up: what was built, why it matters, and step-by-step instructions to repeat it. Capture screenshots of the key steps. Prepare an update for my GitHub portfolio at [repo URL] with a summary card for today. Show me the write-up and the changes before you push anything to GitHub.

curation.rationale: A genuine multi-step workflow where one voice note leads the agent to build a practice IT lab, write it up and update a GitHub portfolio; lightly evidenced and tools are unnamed.
